userStories.title: Thread callContext through SelectorContext, resolveOutcome, and runner contexts
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add `callContext: CallContext` threading through `SelectorContext`, `resolveOutcome()`, `StatefulCtx`, `HybridCtx`, and `toStatefulCtx()` so Phase 1 resolver selectors can dispatch via `callOp`, while leaving stateful/hybrid/plan runner dispatch changes for Phase 2.

**Motivation** — Judge/synthesis selector ops need `callOp` dispatch. Threading `callContext` now unblocks that path while keeping stateful/hybrid/plan dispatch in Phase 2.

**Approach** —
1. Add `readonly callContext: CallContext` to `SelectorContext` in `src/debate/selectors/types.ts`
2. Retain `agentManager: IAgentManager` on `SelectorContext`; `pick` and `majority` still use `completeAs` in Phase 1
3. Add `callContext: CallContext` parameter to `resolveOutcome()` at the position described in the spec (not at the end — alongside other context fields)
4. Place `callContext` on the `selectorCtx` object constructed inside `resolveOutcome()`
5. Add `readonly callContext: CallContext` to `StatefulCtx` in `src/debate/runner-stateful.ts:30`
6. Add `readonly callContext: CallContext` to `HybridCtx` in `src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts:36`
7. Update `toStatefulCtx()` in `src/debate/runner.ts:335` to include `callContext: this.ctx`
8. Update 4 resolveOutcome call sites to pass their CallContext:
   - runner.ts:287 passes `this.ctx`
   - runner-stateful.ts:301 passes `ctx.callContext`
   - runner-hybrid.ts:329 passes `ctx.callContext`
   - runner-plan.ts:295 passes `ctx.callContext` (already exists on PlanCtx)
9. Update `.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md` session role registry: move `synthesis` and `judge` from `agentManager.completeAs` row to `callOp` complete-kind row; update sanctioned-consumers prose to remove the src/debate/ carve-out for resolvers and note #855 Phase 1 has landed
10. Accept the interim resolver session-role regression in Phase 1: `callOp` complete-kind only forwards `ctx.sessionOverride?.role`, so resolver turns no longer preserve `sessionRole: "judge" | "synthesis"` or custom session names until Phase 2

**Interface**
```typescript
// src/debate/selectors/types.ts
export interface SelectorContext {
  // … existing fields …
  readonly callContext: CallContext;
}

// resolveOutcome signature change (parameter position with other context fields, not at end):
export async function resolveOutcome(
  proposalOutputs: string[],
  critiqueOutputs: string[],
  stageConfig: DebateStageConfig,
  config: DebateConfig,
  callContext: CallContext,                    // ← new, required
  storyId: string,
  timeoutMs: number,
  workdir: string | undefined,
  featureName: string | undefined,
  reviewerSession: ReviewerSession | undefined,
  resolverContext: ResolverContext | undefined,
  promptSuffix: string | undefined,
  debaters: Debater[] | undefined,
  agentManager: IAgentManager,
): Promise<ResolveOutcome>
```

**Scope** — In: SelectorContext, resolveOutcome, StatefulCtx, HybridCtx, toStatefulCtx, 4 call sites, adapter-wiring.md, documenting accepted session-role regression. Out: judgeOp, synthesisOp, selector rewrites, cost accounting parity, resolver session-role parity.
acceptanceCriteria: SelectorContext in src/debate/selectors/types.ts declares a readonly callContext: CallContext field
resolveOutcome() in src/debate/session-helpers.ts accepts a callContext: CallContext parameter and places it on the SelectorContext it constructs
StatefulCtx in src/debate/runner-stateful.ts declares a readonly callContext: CallContext field
HybridCtx in src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts declares a readonly callContext: CallContext field
DebateRunner.toStatefulCtx() in src/debate/runner.ts includes callContext: this.ctx in its return object
src/debate/runner.ts:287 passes this.ctx to resolveOutcome
src/debate/runner-stateful.ts:301 passes ctx.callContext to resolveOutcome
src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts:329 passes ctx.callContext to resolveOutcome
src/debate/runner-plan.ts:295 passes ctx.callContext to resolveOutcome
.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md session role registry: synthesis and judge are moved from the agentManager.completeAs row to the callOp complete-kind row
.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md sanctioned-consumers prose: the src/debate/ carve-out for resolvers is removed and #855 Phase 1 is noted as landed
The story description explicitly records that resolver session naming regresses in Phase 1 because callOp complete-kind only forwards ctx.sessionOverride?.role, and that parity is deferred to Phase 2
suggestedCriteria: When resolveOutcome is called without a callContext argument, TypeScript rejects at compile time with a missing argument error
When toStatefulCtx() is called, the returned object contains callContext field equal to this.ctx

userStories.title: Judge resolver as CompleteOperation
acceptanceCriteria: judgeOp is exported from src/operations/index.ts with kind:"complete", name:"debate-judge", stage:"review", config: debateConfigSelector
judgeOp.model(input) returns { agent: input.resolverAgent, model: input.resolverModel } when both fields are non-empty strings
judgeOp.build(input, _ctx) returns the same prompt text as DebatePromptBuilder.resolverJudgePrompt(input.proposals, input.critiques, input.debaters)
judgeOp.parse(output, _input, _ctx) returns the output string unchanged
judgeSelector(ctx) calls callOp(ctx.callContext, judgeOp, …) exactly once per invocation
judgeSelector(ctx) returns SelectorResult { outcome: "passed", output, resolverCostUsd: 0 } when the op result is a non-empty trimmed string
judgeSelector(ctx) returns SelectorResult { outcome: "failed", output, resolverCostUsd: 0 } when the op result is empty or whitespace-only
src/debate/selectors/judge.ts contains no references to resolveConfiguredModel, resolveDefaultAgent, DEFAULT_CONFIG.models, ctx.config.models, or formatSessionName
src/debate/selectors/judge.ts does not call completeAs directly

The story preserves the existing compat entrypoint used by src/debate/resolvers.ts, either by keeping callJudgeComplete available with equivalent behavior or by updating the compat wrapper in the same story
suggestedCriteria: When judgeOp.model receives an input with empty resolverAgent, it returns a valid agent string (fallback behavior should be consistent with pre-callOp behavior)
When callOp(ctx, judgeOp, input) is invoked, the dispatch agent is input.resolverAgent as resolved by resolveConfiguredModel pin mechanism

synthesisOp.build(input, _ctx) returns the same prompt text the current synthesisSelector builds (including promptSuffix handling)

synthesisSelector(ctx) returns SelectorResult { outcome: "passed", output, resolverCostUsd: 0 } when the op result is a non-empty trimmed string
synthesisSelector(ctx) returns SelectorResult { outcome: "failed", output, resolverCostUsd: 0 } when the op result is empty or whitespace-only
src/debate/selectors/synthesis.ts contains no references to resolveConfiguredModel, resolveDefaultAgent, DEFAULT_CONFIG.models, ctx.config.models, or formatSessionName
src/debate/selectors/synthesis.ts does not call completeAs directly

The story preserves the existing compat entrypoint used by src/debate/resolvers.ts, either by keeping callSynthesisComplete available with equivalent behavior or by updating the compat wrapper in the same story
suggestedCriteria: When synthesisOp.build receives an input with promptSuffix set, the returned prompt includes the suffix appended after a blank line separator
When callOp(ctx, synthesisOp, input) is invoked, the dispatch agent is input.resolverAgent

analysis:
**Key files identified:**
- `src/debate/selectors/types.ts` — SelectorContext interface; needs `callContext: CallContext` field
- `src/debate/session-helpers.ts:186-305` — resolveOutcome() function; needs `callContext` parameter and threading
- `src/debate/runner.ts:287` — base runner resolveOutcome call site; `this.ctx` is CallContext
- `src/debate/runner.ts:335` — toStatefulCtx(); needs to include `callContext: this.ctx`
- `src/debate/runner-stateful.ts:30` — StatefulCtx interface; needs `callContext: CallContext` field
- `src/debate/runner-stateful.ts:301` — stateful runner resolveOutcome call site; passes ctx.callContext
- `src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts:36` — HybridCtx interface; needs `callContext: CallContext` field
- `src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts:329` — hybrid runner resolveOutcome call site; passes ctx.callContext
- `src/debate/runner-plan.ts:295` — plan runner resolveOutcome call site; already has `callContext: ctx.callContext`
- `src/debate/selectors/judge.ts` — judgeSelector; calls resolveConfiguredModel + completeAs; must rewrite to callOp
- `src/debate/selectors/synthesis.ts` — synthesisSelector; same pattern as judge
- `src/operations/debate-propose.ts` — sibling CompleteOperation; reference for model() resolver shape
- `src/operations/index.ts` — exports all ops; judgeOp/synthesisOp must be added here
- `src/operations/call.ts:101-178` — callOp complete-kind path; handles { agent, model } pin
- `src/prompts/builders/debate-builder.ts:381` — resolverSynthesisPrompt; line 404 resolverJudgePrompt
- `.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md:45` — session role registry; synthesis+judge are in agentManager.completeAs row

**Architecture decisions:**
- callContext is threaded through SelectorContext so judgeSelector/synthesisSelector can call callOp
- StatefulCtx and HybridCtx each get a `readonly callContext: CallContext` field; toStatefulCtx() includes it
- Plan runner already has callContext on PlanCtx; its resolveOutcome call is unchanged except adding the parameter
- judgeOp and synthesisOp are CompleteOperation<DebateJudgeInput, string, DebateConfig> exported from operations/index.ts
- Op model() returns { agent, model } to override ctx.agentName via resolveConfiguredModel pin mechanism

**Migration notes:**
- 4 call sites of resolveOutcome must pass callContext: runner.ts:287 (this.ctx), runner-stateful.ts:301 (ctx.callContext), runner-hybrid.ts:329 (ctx.callContext), runner-plan.ts:295 (ctx.callContext already exists)
- New files: src/operations/debate-judge.ts, src/operations/debate-synthesis.ts
- selectorCtx construction in resolveOutcome at line 244 must include callContext field
- adapter-wiring.md session role registry: synthesis+judge move from agentManager.completeAs row to callOp complete-kind row

**Tests:**
- test/unit/debate/selectors/judge.test.ts and synthesis.test.ts exist; must update for callOp path
- fakeAgentManager helper available at test/helpers/fake-agent-manager.ts
